scope: Artifact persistence, restoration and promotion only; no scientific validation claim.

findings: Hash could be mistaken for backup
Local upload visibility was not durable availability

rounds.finding: Receipt hash was computed before restore state was appended
rounds.repair: Compute receipt hash only over the final receipt after restore decision and any fail-closed demotion

rounds.finding: Restore phase could dereference an undeclared store after preflight rejection
rounds.repair: Restore is prohibited unless preflight authorized; defensive store/path resolution retained

residuals: Remote APIs must independently implement authenticated readback and CAS

fixed_point_definition: No newly identified in-scope bypass remains after regression suite; external capabilities remain explicit prerequisites.
